item.title: 【DVD】DVD9 - YG FAMILY CONCERT 2012 in JAPAN (3x DVDISO)
item.description:
YG FAMILY CONCERT 2012 in JAPAN (3x DVDISO)​


​
YG FAMILY CONCERT 2012 in JAPAN is YG Family's third live DVD and first Japanese exclusive release. It was released in two versions, a limited edition housed in a digipack including a "Making of" DVD, and a regular 2DVD edition. The DVD features almost the same tracklist as the Korean release 15th Anniversary 2011 "YG FAMILY CONCERT LIVE in SEOUL" as both concerts belong to the same tour, however the Japanese DVD includes Japanese songs performed by the artists debuted there. The concert also features Komuro Tetsuya as guest for a globe cover.
